# buildProject()

> **buildProject**(`project?`: `string`, `options?`: [`ProjectBuildOptions`](../interfaces/ProjectBuildOptions.md) & `object`): [`BuildResult`](../interfaces/BuildResult.md)

Defined in: [src/project/build.ts:62](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/project/build.ts#L62)

Compile the source-package graph against the effective game roots and validate the resulting mod. A failed build leaves the last successful output in place.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default value |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `project?` | `string` | `"."` |
| `options?` | [`ProjectBuildOptions`](../interfaces/ProjectBuildOptions.md) & `object` | `{}` |

## Returns

[`BuildResult`](../interfaces/BuildResult.md)

## Example

```ts
const result = buildProject("./my-mod", { gameRoots: ["/games/hoi4", "/mods/Kaiserreich"] });
if (!result.success) console.error(result.diagnostics);
```
